name: kb_matmul_small_k
description: Matrix multiplication C = A @ B with a small reduction dimension K. This problem is launch-overhead-bound because the reduction dimension is tiny (K << M, N), making efficient kernel launch and memory access patterns critical. The small K dimension means less compute per output element, amplifying the impact of launch overhead and memory latency. Optimizations should focus on minimizing kernel launch overhead, efficient work distribution, and maximizing memory bandwidth utilization.

M.description: Number of rows in A and output C

N.description: Number of columns in B and output C

K.description: Reduction dimension (small: typically K << M, N)
